director.name: 萨利姆·萨拉瓦蒂 Salem Salavati

introduction: Kavan is a teenage boy with Down syndrome who lives with his mother and older brother. His father passed away many years ago.He has reached puberty and was recently seen masturbation away in the neighborhood where they live (due to his special and involuntary condition). This behavior was neither accepted nor understood by the people of the neighborhood and has caused many problems for them and his.His mother sought various options and paths to solve this problem—such as consulting a welfare counselor, a religious prayer writer, local elders, and the mosque—but it became clear that in their community, where social and legal relations are mostly based on tradition and religion, there is no suitable or definite solution. This situation caused their isolation and forced them to resort to unconventional and unwanted options chosen by the mother. Ultimately, tension with a neighbor led Kavan to take an involuntary and dangerous action, which pushed his mother toward a final option suggested by one of the neighbors, leading her to a deeper and more bitter understanding of the society around her.
